summary: Backend public routes and live Google Sheets sync passed; login failure handling and responsive login UI passed. Authenticated workspace could not be tested because no credentials are provisioned.

critical.issue: CRM read, update, export, and sync routes have no authentication or role dependency, so any caller can access or mutate CRM data.
JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded development secret when the environment variable is absent; production startup should fail fast instead.

minor.issue: overdue is always returned as 0 rather than calculated from due dates.
by_bdm is always empty and follow-up due/overdue breakdown is not implemented.

integration_issues.issue: Not testable until an owner account is provisioned; no credentials exist in test_credentials.md.
Countdown is hardcoded to '04:58' and does not decrement or reflect sync metadata.
Export downloads JSON named nova-leads.json despite the requested CSV export.
Buttons render but have no handlers/API integration, so actions do nothing.

action_items: Require authenticated role-aware access on all CRM and sync endpoints.
Remove JWT secret fallback and require a production environment secret.
Provision a test owner account before authenticated E2E verification.
Implement live countdown, CSV export, follow-up actions, reminders, and allocation persistence.
critical_code_review_comments: current_user is not attached to any route and its token dependency is lambda: None, so it cannot authenticate requests even if used.
fetch_sheet deletes every lead before inserting the sheet contents; this destructive behavior needs scoped/idempotent synchronization and protection behind owner permissions.
The frontend displays static pipeline values and BDM workload values that are not backed by APIs.
seed_data_creation: None; no credentials or records were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public API suite and login failure flow pass. Continue with provisioned owner credentials to test workspace navigation, lead filters, update actions, follow-ups, allocation, and export.
rca of the issue: The backend defines current_user but never wires it into route dependencies, while the frontend includes several presentational controls without callbacks. This makes the shell appear feature-complete but leaves authorization and core mutations unimplemented.
